description: A Java class 'BufferHolder' that manages a resizable data buffer for unsafe row serialization in Apache Spark, allowing buffer growth and re-pointing of the unsafe row to the buffer.

classes.name: BufferHolder
classes.description: A helper class to manage and grow a data buffer for an unsafe row in Spark SQL, ensuring efficient memory management and re-pointing.

methods.name: BufferHolder
methods.description: Constructor initializing BufferHolder with a given UnsafeRow and optional initial size.

methods.name: grow
methods.description: Grows the buffer to accommodate additional needed size and re-points the row to the new buffer.

methods.name: getBuffer
methods.description: Returns the current buffer byte array.

methods.name: getCursor
methods.description: Returns the current cursor position within the buffer.

methods.name: increaseCursor
methods.description: Increases the cursor position by a specified value.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the cursor to the position after the fixed size, preparing for new data.

methods.name: totalSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of data written in the buffer.
